answer: The design leans on ephemeral memory consumption bounds that render bulk automated spawning intractable. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Reaching the cipher of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a analytical prose structured with explicit logical operators and causality register, it stays short. The lotus lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the harbor is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
